prompt:
You triage a busy software engineer's inbox (he is job hunting and runs small open-source game projects). Sort each item into exactly one bin:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Your own sorting rubric from last round:
* If the subject contains a question mark, sort into 'reply' if the senderType is 'collaborator' or 'recruiter', otherwise sort into 'archive'.
* If the subject contains the word 'invoice', sort into 'archive' if the senderType is 'invoice', otherwise sort into 'info'.
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him sort it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
p029 | Finance · co-working space | Membership invoice – missing VAT number | To issue the invoice to your company we need your VAT number and billing address.
p037 | Recruiter · Halvsjö Partners | Role in Oslo or Copenhagen? | I have two similar roles. Before I introduce you: which city, and is relocation an option?
r002-qwen2515b-06 | Service · MyProject | Service Request: Network Issue | We noticed a network issue with your project. Please check the logs.
r002-llama323b-01 | Job-Board · TechHub | New Job Opening: Junior DevOps Engineer | We are looking for a talented Junior DevOps Engineer to join our team.
r002-qwen2515b-08 | Job Board · TechJobs | New Job Posting: Full Stack Developer | We are seeking a Full Stack Developer with experience in both frontend and backend.
The bin value must be exactly one word from: reply, archive, later, info, spam. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","bin":"later","summary":"Weekly digest, read later"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
raw: {"items":[{"id":"p029","bin":"info","summary":"Missing VAT number, clarify details"},{"id":"p037","bin":"reply","summary":"City and relocation option, respond now"},{"id":"r002-qwen2515b-06","bin":"archive","summary":"Network issue, FYI"},{"id":"r002-llama323b-01","bin":"spam","summary":"Job posting, marketing"},{"id":"r002-qwen2515b-08","bin":"later","summary":"Job posting, read later"}]}
